title: Change Cascade
premise: At 02:00 UTC the Ledger API started timing out and payments failed for 25 minutes. Six systems each saw part of it. None of them agree on what anything is called. What explains it?

sources.name: Access & Activity Log
sources.blurb: One JSON object per line. Epoch milliseconds. Knows badge IDs, never names.

sources.name: Metrics Mesh
sources.blurb: Column-oriented: a schema, then bare arrays. Epoch seconds, service IDs, no context.

sources.name: Change & Ticket System
sources.blurb: XML export. Facts hide in attributes; people are lowercase emails.

sources.name: People Directory
sources.blurb: HR export. Pipe-delimited, names as 'LAST, First', dates as dd/mm/yyyy, email case all over the place.

sources.name: Flow Telemetry
sources.blurb: A collector's query response: metadata envelope, camelCase, records three levels deep.

sources.name: Partner Advisory Feed
sources.blurb: key=value lines from outside the company. Free-text subjects, misspelled names, self-reported confidence.
